text:
Alex: looping in @Tara and @Lia — EdgeCloud partner asked about SSO and enterprise pricing for the joint POC. Need SSO doc + quotation by EOD.
Tara: thanks, Alex. Lia do you have SAML metadata or IdP details? we can prod for cert chain.
Lia (EdgeCloud): yes, we can share test IdP. Our tenant supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. I'll DM the metadata URL now.
Lia (EdgeCloud): https://edgecloud.test/idp/metadata — note it's ephemeral until we finish onboarding
Josh (Sales): budgeting question: partner expects an estimate for 2x rtx-a10 nodes, 50k tokens/day, 3 month POC — what number do we quote?
Tara: rough calc: hosted incl. 2 GPUs + bandwidth + support = ~$12k/mo. I'll get exact and post line-item.
Alex: also there's an enterprise security questionnaire — Lia can we get their infosec contact? we should skip sharing customer data until NDA signed.
Lia (EdgeCloud): infosec is security@edgecloud.co, happy to run the questionnaire. NDA is already signed last week (I can attach)
Security Bot: INFOSEC CHECK: remember to redact any sample logs before sharing. :lock:
Tara: thanks. @Alex can you attach the questionnaire template? I'll fill initial answers and flag any vendor blockers.
Alex: uploading questionnaire template
```
---
Vendor: Redwood Inference
Scope: co-sell POC between Redwood + EdgeCloud
Questions: encryption at rest, key management, pen testing, data residency
---
```
Tara: Q: KMS integration — we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM for Private deployments; for Hosted we can offer dedicated key enclaves (enterprise add-on). I'll note that.
Lia (EdgeCloud): network question — will we need to open ports? partner's infra is strict.
Tara: POC plan: we can do VPC peering for Dedicated or use SSO + HTTPS if hosted. I'll create a runbook.
Alex: blocker: partner asked about runtime fallback to smaller model during capacity spikes. Ops needs to sign off. @DevBot can you create a runbook ticket?
DevBot: created ticket INF-2194 with runbook template (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2194)
Josh (Sales): great — pls include an estimate for SLA uplift cost.
Tara: noted. I'll send a one-pager and a price band by tomorrow morning.
Lia (EdgeCloud): thanks everyone. I'll share IdP cert and infosec contact in DM. :thumbsup:
Alex: perfect. closing loop — we'll meet Thursday 10am PT to sync with partner and legal.
Josh (Sales): calendar invite sent.
